baseline.description: Ordinary synthetic application traffic with varied clients, paths, and user-agent families.
baseline.label: normal

rate_deviation.description: A subset of synthetic clients has a shorter inter-arrival interval than the baseline.
rate_deviation.label: behavioral_deviation

client_concentration.description: Synthetic requests are concentrated among fewer client identities.
client_concentration.label: behavioral_deviation

path_concentration.description: Synthetic requests are concentrated on a small subset of application paths.
path_concentration.label: behavioral_deviation

user_agent_shift.description: The distribution of synthetic user-agent families changes from the baseline.
user_agent_shift.label: behavioral_deviation
